label: Maintenance dredging
descriptor: Periodic dredging campaigns to keep the access channel navigable.

label: Cargo terminal (land site)
descriptor: Cargo terminal and industrial plant on land; its paved area drains to the bay.

label: Vessel traffic and operation
descriptor: Ship traffic and berthing operations in the port.

label: Surface runoff
descriptor: Rainwater runoff from the terminal, carrying metals.

label: Sediment resuspension
descriptor: Fine sediment put back in suspension by dredging and ship propellers.

label: Water turbidity
descriptor: Water turbidity (clears within weeks once resuspension stops).

label: Dissolved Zn in water
descriptor: Dissolved zinc in the water column (persists; slow to clear).

label: Dissolved Cu in water
descriptor: Dissolved copper in the water column (persists; slow to clear).

label: Behavioral alterations of fauna
descriptor: Changes in fish and invertebrate behaviour under turbid water (reversible).

label: Biota contamination (seafood)
descriptor: Metal accumulation in fish and shellfish eaten by people (bioaccumulates; slow to reverse).

label: Water quality loss (CONAMA classes)
descriptor: Loss of the water-quality class set by CONAMA Resolution 357 (legal compliance).

label: Loss of primary production
descriptor: Loss of phytoplankton primary production when turbidity blocks light.

label: Runoff treatment system
descriptor: Collection and treatment of the terminal's runoff before it reaches the bay.

label: Environmental work window
descriptor: Dredging restricted to the environmentally least sensitive period.

label: Best practices adoption
descriptor: General good practices (dredging methods, speed limits, housekeeping).
